title: Battery Expiration Check Expired Batteries Leaderboard
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=battery:expiration batteries_expired=*
| stats sum(batteries_expired) as total_value, avg(batteries_expired) as avg_value by device_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average expired batteries across battery expiration check events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `batteries_expired` values for each battery expiration check event and review total and average expired batteries by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total expired batteries.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which device shows the biggest expired batteries numbers in your battery expiration check data.
